nameOrigin: one of a cluster of small flowers

pokedexEntries.x: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

pokedexEntries.or: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

pokedexEntries.y: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

pokedexEntries.as: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

pokedexEntries.us: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

pokedexEntries.um: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon draws forth what power is left in withered flowers to make them healthy again. It holds a red flower.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

pokedexEntries.za: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.
